g.text: The path of one benchmark case
Setup: not timed (prepare)
a new test chain over an in-memory store
the system processes, the funded deploy key
setup deploys: the factory call of the space
each one checked for no error, then a checkpoint
a fill deploy of ten sends in a use block
or of one send after ten did not fit
the deploy fits the v6 limits?
yes
no
checkpoint: the new pre-state root
the deploy had more than one send?
yes
no
reset to the last root
continue with one send in each deploy
record
the collection is full at r records
the contract holds this outcome
yes
records left to store?
no
Reference play: checked, not timed (observe)
evaluate the measured deploy once
with a fresh v6 host-work budget and a phlo limit of
read the values on the result channel, the phlo
and the used host work of each dimension
checkpoint: the root after the deploy
the run fails: the contract does not hold
no
result, phlo, root and host work equal the contract?
yes
append the record line: the observed values,
the setup time and the reference time
no timing: the series stops at this count
yes
the deploy failed, for example with HostWorkRejected?
no
Timed iterations (iter_custom)
reset the chain to the pre-state root
outside the timer
start the timer
parse and normalize the source text
recognize the marker tuples of use and of the params
reduce: each space operation runs as a space job
under the deterministic operation order
metered view reads: reserve the key and the whole loaded value
then load the records of the channel into the staged view
match, stage and commit: the events
and the observer calls that charge the phlo
checkpoint of the history trie
yes
the case includes the checkpoint?
no
stop the timer: one iteration of the sample
iterations left in the sample?
yes
Criterion: ten samples of equal iterations (flat sampling)
the median and its 95 % bootstrap interval
no
Concept colors
host code at the baseline and the test chain
the factory call of a space
records, the history trie and checkpoints
evaluation and space jobs
substrate: metered view reads, staging and commit
syntax: parse, normalization and marker tuples
timer and statistics
an outcome without timing, or a failed run
